crew.overview: After finding themselves ensnared in a death trap, seven disillusioned castoffs must embark on a dangerous mission that will force them to confront the darkest corners of their pasts.
crew.title: Thunderbolts*

crew.overview: Natasha Romanoff, also known as Black Widow, confronts the darker parts of her ledger when a dangerous conspiracy with ties to her past arises. Pursued by a force that will stop at nothing to bring her down, Natasha must deal with her history as a spy and the broken relationships left in her wake long before she became an Avenger.
crew.title: Black Widow

crew.overview: Thor is imprisoned on the other side of the universe and finds himself in a race against time to get back to Asgard to stop Ragnarok, the destruction of his home-world and the end of Asgardian civilization, at the hands of a powerful new threat, the ruthless Hela.
crew.title: Thor: Ragnarok

details.biography:
Brian Chapek is an American film producer and a a Production, Development, and Creative executive at Marvel Studios.

Chapek started out as an assistant to Brad Winderbaum and was eventually promoted to assistant producer on Thor: Ragnarok (2017), producer on the short film Team Darryl (2018), co-producer on Black Widow (2021), and executive producer on Thor: Love and Thunder (2022) and Thunderbolts (2025). He is the son of Bob Chapek, former CEO of The Walt Disney Company from 2020 to 2022.
details.name: Brian Chapek
